title: Salinity Drift After ATO Events
dataSources: Reef-tank parameters (`reeftank:param`), auto-top-off events (`ato:event`), dosing and feeding events (`doser:event`, `reeftank:feeding`), planted-tank CO2 (`plantedtank:co2`), quarantine observations (`quarantine:observation`), frag lighting (`fraglight:reading`), and leak telemetry (`leaksensor:event`).
app: Aquarium and vivarium telemetry from Neptune Apex, GHL, ESPHome, leak sensors, dosing systems, planted-tank controllers, quarantine logs, and PAR meters streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and controller APIs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ato:event
| eval salinity_delta=post_salinity_ppt-pre_salinity_ppt
| eval abs_salinity_delta=abs(salinity_delta)
| stats avg(salinity_delta) as avg_salinity_delta max(abs_salinity_delta) as max_abs_salinity_delta by tank
description: Shows whether auto-top-off events are followed by salinity swings that are larger than expected.
value: ATO systems should smooth salinity, so tracking post-event drift quickly reveals calibration or reservoir issues.
implementation: Log pre- and post-ATO salinity readings from the controller or periodic probes for each tank.
visualization: Table of average and worst salinity delta after ATO events.
grandmaExplanation: It warns whether topping off evaporated water is nudging salinity around more than it should.
